why: owner 27 Nov: new version 1.1.9 on game build 71139, replaces the 1.1.8.470 release

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.9.475-beta (draft build 475) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Changed
- The data is now marked for the current game build 1.60.1.71139. On build 71091 data every module showed 'warn' in /wfa status just because the game was one hotfix newer. That warning is gone.

Fixed (from 1.1.8.470)
- Action bar spell tooltip flashed English for a moment before the Persian: the tooltip is translated at once again, right after the game builds it, from a secure hook.
- Action bar 'blocked in combat' (MultiBar...:SetShown / SetAttribute on a mouseover): the spell and unit tooltip work now runs from a secure hook, after the game's function, never inside it.
- A unit the game does not clearly mark as an NPC is never looked up, so a player's name can never reach the NPC miss list.
- The error list now starts empty after an update.
- A blocked action still names the last WoWFA hook that ran just before it.

New (from 1.1.8)
- Report page: a blinking button 'How can I help WoWFarsi?' opens a 4-step tour.
- About page: who makes WoWFA and a note asking players to support the project on wowfarsi.ir.
- A hunter's 'Call <pet name>' spell is shown in Persian with the pet's own name.
- 19 more NPC names, 10 more NPC talk and spell-rank texts, and the red alert 'There is nothing to attack.' in Persian.

This version replaces 1.1.8.470-beta, which was withdrawn.

Everything from 1.1.8 is included.
